how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:warlock-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:1805:obj:0: Bring the Reconstructed Tome and 3 Rods of Channeling to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.
rows.quest:1805:details:0: This is one of the most interesting texts I have perused in the last few years. The selection here is sparse--mostly books on geography--and I have already read them all. I should hope that Strahad would send me a copy of this tome when he has the chance.
rows.quest:1805:details:1: BSpeaking of him, he sent word to me while you were away. For your task, you must obtain three rods of channeling.
rows.quest:1805:details:2: BFor allowing me to look at this text, I will share a secret: You can find the rods on orcs of the Dragonmaw Clan in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1805:completion:0: Well done! The Tome of the Cabal and three pristine--slightly scratched, I suppose--rods of channeling.
rows.quest:1805:completion:1: BThis will be interesting. It's been some time since a young warlock took on a felhunter to make his own.
rows.quest:2996:obj:0: Speak to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.
rows.quest:2996:details:0: I have taught you skills in the past, but the time has come for another to teach you. He is in Ratchet, and his name is Strahad. He is human, but do not let that fool you into thinking he is weak. He is powerful even though he may be small. He can teach you about more powerful summonings--I feel you are ready. Go to him now. He is in Ratchet... above the port town next to his tower.
rows.quest:2996:completion:0: A busy day in Ratchet, isn't it? How I enjoy watching the toil of a port city. So much mystery, so much adventure... so much ignorance.
rows.quest:2996:completion:1: BIs that hatred I see in your eyes, ⟦1⟧? Good, we will put that to good use.
rows.quest:3001:details:0: I have taught you skills in the past, but the time has come for another to teach you. He is in Ratchet, and his name is Strahad. He is human, but do not let that fool you into thinking he is weak, nor is he your enemy... at least for now. He is powerful and should be respected. He can teach you about greater summonings, summonings I feel you are prepared for. Go to him now.
rows.quest:3001:details:1: BYou can find him in Ratchet... above the port town next to the tower there.
rows.quest:3001:completion:0: A busy day in Ratchet, isn't it? How I enjoy watching the toil of a port city. So much mystery, so much adventure... so much ignorance.
rows.quest:3001:completion:1: BIs that hatred I see in your eyes, ⟦2⟧? Good, we will put that to good use.
rows.quest:3090:obj:0: Read the Tainted Parchment and speak to Nartok inside the Den in the Valley of Trials.
rows.quest:3090:details:0: Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, ⟦3⟧.
rows.quest:3090:details:1: BI usually avoid dealing with warlocks if I can help it, but I think you should read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from your newly-appointed trainer Nartok. He would have words with you when you're ready.
rows.quest:3090:completion:0: And now you've joined our ranks also. Don't misunderstand, ⟦4⟧. Just because you have access to power that many will be jealous of, it does not mean you will be accepted easily. Thrall allows our kind into ⟦E2⟧ because we are still his fellow kin--he cannot turn his back on us, or we would become as pathetic as the humans who enslaved him. My point is: be careful. You can be powerful, but if you are foolish, then you are as good dead.
rows.quest:3090:completion:1: BIf you need training in spells then return to me.
rows.quest:3099:obj:0: Read the Tainted Scroll and speak to Maximillion in Deathknell.
rows.quest:3099:details:0: Ah, while you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. I would think it's some matter of importance as it seems it bears the seal of the warlock trainer Maximillion. I would take some time to read it before heading out again.
rows.quest:3099:completion:0: I mentioned a slave still being a slave, no matter the master. Do you remember? We both know that it is that type of control--that type of power--that now drives us. We seek to have creatures serve us. We know we are more powerful and deserve more respect than others give us ... and so now we look to take it.
rows.quest:3099:completion:1: BI will be your ally in this struggle--the struggle for our own freedom. Freedom to seek our own allegiances. When you feel ready, return to me and I will teach you all I know.
rows.quest:3105:obj:0: Read the Tainted Letter and speak to Drusilla La Salle next to ⟦E3⟧ Abbey.
rows.quest:3105:details:0: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, ⟦5⟧. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Drusilla, one of our local trainers. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
rows.quest:3105:completion:0: As you grow in power, you will be tempted--you must always remember to control yourself. I will not lie--corruption can come to any practitioner of the arcane; especially one who deals with creatures from the ⟦E4⟧. Be patient, and be prudent... but do not let that repress your ambition.
rows.quest:3105:completion:1: BAs you grow more powerful, return to me and I will teach you more about our ways.
rows.quest:3115:obj:0: Read the Tainted Memorandum and speak to Alamar Grimm inside Anvilmar above Coldridge Valley.
rows.quest:3115:details:0: While you were helping me out, this memorandum was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the warlock trainer Alamar. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
rows.quest:3115:details:1: BAnd watch yerself, ⟦6⟧, your kind ain't too trusted 'round these parts.
rows.quest:3115:completion:0: But none of that matters. What matters is that you've seen your own ⟦E5⟧! You know where power truly comes from. You realize that having our own allies is much more... prudent. Special allies. Allies that, no matter the task, will obey till their last breath.
rows.quest:3115:completion:1: BAnd that's where I come in, ⟦7⟧. I can train you in the beginnings of those special powers. Seek me out often and I will do what I can to teach you more spells.
rows.quest:3631:obj:0: Speak to Strahad Farsan in the ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:3631:details:0: Hmph. I say you're not prepared, but that is not my decision. Strahad feels otherwise, and it is his decision to make... this time.
rows.quest:3631:details:1: BHe wishes to speak to you, and quickly. You'll find him still above Ratchet in the ⟦E6⟧, at his little tower there with his acolytes.
rows.quest:3631:completion:0: Good luck, ⟦8⟧. I look forward to seeing you in the future.
rows.quest:4487:obj:0: Speak to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.
rows.quest:4487:details:0: Ah, good, you're here. I sent a ⟦9⟧ after you to get your attention, but it seems you were able to get here before it found you. No matter.
rows.quest:4487:details:1: BThere has been some talk lately of your growing power--that is good for you, possibly bad for others. But those are irrelevant points. The point is, I feel you've proven yourself and therefore are deserving of... hehe... a blessing of sorts.
rows.quest:4487:details:2: BAbove Ratchet in the ⟦E6⟧ you'll find a man named Strahad. I believe you've crossed paths before.
rows.quest:4488:obj:0: Speak to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.
rows.quest:4488:details:0: Ah, ⟦10⟧, you've seen fit to grace us with your presence. How wonderful!
rows.quest:4488:details:1: BI hope you do not expect us to wait on you hand and foot also. You may be growing quickly in power, but you still are a pup when it comes to true knowledge and understanding. If you're not careful, corruption will overwhelm you and your weak will.
rows.quest:4488:details:2: BBut I should get to the point: Strahad wishes to speak to you. He is still residing in his tower overlooking Ratchet in the ⟦E6⟧. I suggest not taking too long.
rows.quest:4489:obj:0: Speak to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.
rows.quest:4489:details:1: BYou're the one they call ⟦12⟧, yes?
rows.quest:4489:details:2: BI thought as much. I will keep this short: you're growing in power, and it has been acknowledged. And now, the time has come that you are rewarded for your efforts.
rows.quest:4489:details:3: BGo to the ⟦E6⟧. There, above Ratchet, you'll find Strahad Farsan--perhaps you remember him? He would have words with you. I wouldn't take long.
rows.quest:4489:completion:0: So, you've decided to grace my presence again. How kind of you.
rows.quest:4489:completion:1: BMy acolytes wondered if you'd ever show up. I told them there was no doubt. When power is concerned, you are drawn in like a moth to the flame.
rows.quest:4490:obj:0: Speak to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet to learn the ability to summon a Felsteed.
rows.quest:4490:details:0: I would give you a reward for your patience and hard work. But know this, the ability to summon a Felsteed will be much more difficult in the future. You will have to earn it... and it will not be easy.
rows.quest:4490:details:1: BFor now, go with the power to summon such a creature and use it as you see fit.
rows.quest:4490:completion:0: Good luck, ⟦13⟧. I look forward to seeing you in the future.
rows.quest:4736:obj:0: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:4736:details:0: Ah, hello, ⟦14⟧. You're progressing well in your training. So well in fact that I think you should be rewarded for your hard work--and for not becoming corrupted by the arcane yet.
rows.quest:4736:details:1: BIf you're interested, seek out Menara Voidrender in Ratchet. She is currently staying at Strahad Farsan's tower overlooking the town.
rows.quest:4736:details:2: BShe's not very friendly, ⟦15⟧, so don't expect any praise. But if you work hard, she'll make sure you're taken care of.
rows.quest:4736:completion:0: Ah, Briarthorn sent you. Good. Then word does reach far enough to find future students. This pleases me.
rows.quest:4736:completion:1: BIt is typical of our kind, ⟦16⟧, to band together, regardless of race. It is especially important since those we deal with most do not discriminate in their malice if we fail to appease them or control them properly.
rows.quest:4736:completion:2: BI feel you've learned a great many things, and if you are willing, I would help you create tools to compliment your skills.
rows.quest:4737:obj:0: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:4737:details:0: Hmph, still you strive to become more powerful. I say it's only time before the corruption and addiction takes hold of you and you become a slave to that which you seek to gain power over.
rows.quest:4737:details:1: BPfah! A fool you are! Time will prove me right--nothing else... just time.
rows.quest:4737:details:2: BBut it seems that not all agree with Zevrost. It seems Menara would create tools for you to become more powerful and to harness your strength. If you're interested, then go to Ratchet in the ⟦E6⟧. She is there overlooking the town.
rows.quest:4737:completion:0: Ah, Zevrost sent you. Good. Then word does reach far enough to find future students. This pleases me.
rows.quest:4737:completion:1: BIt is typical of our kind, ⟦17⟧, to band together, regardless of race. It is especially important since those we deal with most do not discriminate in their malice if we fail to appease them or control them properly.
rows.quest:4737:completion:2: BI feel you've learned a great many things, and if you are willing, I would help you create tools to compliment your skills.
rows.quest:4738:obj:0: Speak with Menara Voidrender in the ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:4738:details:0: Let us be clear about one thing, ⟦18⟧: I don't feel you are ready for such responsibilities. I don't think aiding in the creation of any item of power is something a novice should ever be involved in; especially one so untested.
rows.quest:4738:details:1: BBut that's not my decision. The powers that be, or at least the ones that do wish to impart such gifts upon you get to decide that.
rows.quest:4738:details:2: BIf you're interested in learning more, I suggest you seek out Menara Voidrender in Ratchet. She usually resides in the tower above the port town.
rows.quest:4738:completion:0: Ah, Demisette sent you. Good. Then word does reach far enough to find future students. This pleases me.
rows.quest:4738:completion:1: BIt is typical of our kind, ⟦19⟧, to band together, regardless of race. It is especially important since those we deal with most do not discriminate in their malice if we fail to appease them or control them properly.
rows.quest:4738:completion:2: BI feel you've learned a great many things, and if you are willing, I would help you create tools to compliment your skills.
rows.quest:4739:obj:0: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:4739:details:1: BYou don't have all the accoutrements, but it's plain to see you're ready--the air around you exudes greater confidence. Yes, I see it now.
rows.quest:4739:details:2: BMenara Voidrender would teach you a few things if you feel you're ready. She spends her time tutoring younger students in the arcane. She even gives gifts to those who pass her tests.
rows.quest:4739:details:3: BGo to Ratchet in the ⟦E6⟧ if you're interested. She's above the city in Strahad's tower.
rows.quest:4739:completion:0: Ah, Kaal sent you. Good. Then word does reach far enough to find future students. This pleases me.
rows.quest:4739:completion:1: BIt is typical of our kind, ⟦21⟧, to band together, regardless of race. It is especially important since those we deal with most do not discriminate in their malice if we fail to appease them or control them properly.
rows.quest:4739:completion:2: BI feel you've learned a great many things, and if you are willing, I would help you create tools to compliment your skills.
rows.quest:4781:obj:0: Bring a Gold Bar to Xizk Goodstitch in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:4781:details:0: Your next task is as simple as your first, but will require you to seek out aid.
rows.quest:4781:details:1: BI require gold thread for the embroidery of the cloak, but gold thread is not easy to come by, and very few know how to make it. Fortunately, one who is loyal to our cause knows its secrets and is willing to help those rising in our ranks.
rows.quest:4781:details:2: BBring a gold bar to Xizk Goodstitch in Booty Bay. He is a master tailor and will be happy to spin the thread for you. Gold bars are smelted by skilled miners. Ask a miner for help.
rows.quest:4781:completion:0: Perfect, ⟦22⟧. I'm glad you could find a miner to help you out so quickly. Or did you do this work yourself? Either way, you've done well. This will be perfect for the thread.
rows.quest:4781:completion:1: BIt will take some time to create the stuff, so you'll have to come back--I actually send it off to some princess who we have locked in a tower who's only job is to spin gold thread... no, seriously. I mean it... okay, not really.
rows.quest:4782:obj:0: Return to Menara Voidrender in the ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:4782:details:0: Return to Menara, tell her it'll take some time, but I'll make sure to come through for her... and you. Tell her to have you finish gathering the rest of your components--I should have the thread done by then. You can return and pick it up then.
rows.quest:4782:details:1: BGood luck, ⟦23⟧. Oh, and say hello to Strahad for me while you're there. That old coot... putting a tower right there next to Ratchet... crazy.
rows.quest:4782:completion:0: Good, you've returned, ⟦24⟧. And where is the thread?
rows.quest:4782:completion:1: BAh, I understand. That is acceptable. The goblin and his brother have not failed us yet--I suppose it is understandable that he did not have it prepared right then. So be it... we have other things we can attend to in the meantime.
rows.quest:4782:completion:2: BAre you prepared for the next step?
rows.quest:4783:obj:0: Bring 10 Vials of Hatefury Blood and 1 Lesser Infernal Stone to Menara Voidrender in the ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:4783:details:0: The next components are found in ⟦E8⟧, far to the west of the ⟦E6⟧ and even the ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:4783:details:1: BThere, chaos still reigns after the Sundering. Both your strength and cunning will be tested there--you will face creatures of hatred and also of the ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:4783:details:2: BFrom the Hatefury satyr in the northeast, bring me their blood. From the lesser infernals in Mannoroc Coven, bring me a lesser infernal stone.
rows.quest:4783:details:3: BWe will use both in the construction of your robe.
rows.quest:4783:completion:0: Excellent, ⟦25⟧. These will do nicely. I will prepare them now while you move on to your last two components. Are you ready?
rows.quest:4784:obj:0: Bring some Fine Gold Thread, 2 Smoldering Coals, and a ⟦E11⟧ to Menara Voidrender in the ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:4784:details:0: I need only three things now, ⟦26⟧, then we can finish your robe.
rows.quest:4784:details:1: BFirst, the fine gold thread Xizk is making for you. Return to him in Booty Bay and get it.
rows.quest:4784:details:2: BSecond, bring me two smoldering coals from the fire elementals in the ⟦E12⟧. If I recall correctly, they are to the west, near Thoradin's Wall.
rows.quest:4784:details:3: BFinally, a soul shard created by you.
rows.quest:4784:details:4: BAfter you have all the components, return here to the tower and I will complete the robe for you.
rows.quest:4784:completion:0: Excellent, ⟦27⟧! The components are gathered and we are ready.
rows.quest:4784:completion:1: BI trust you will be pleased.
rows.quest:4786:obj:0: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete your robe and then speak to her again.
rows.quest:4786:details:0: I will put the robe together for you now. It will take but a few moments. Do not go far.
rows.quest:4786:completion:0: It is done, ⟦28⟧. Here you are. Wear it with pride.
rows.quest:4786:completion:1: BYou've worked hard and I see great things in your future. Remember, to defy the corruption that comes with our path takes great will and fortitude. As long as your will is your own, then you shall have great success.
rows.quest:4961:obj:0: Kill the Demon of the Orb, then speak with Tabetha.
rows.quest:4961:details:0: Ah, a summoner's orb--this is where the taint must be coming from. We must exorcise the demon within it if you're to use it. That I can do easily.
rows.quest:4961:details:1: BYou're the one who has the hard job. You must kill the demon once I release it.
rows.quest:4961:details:2: BAnd you'll have to be quick. If you take too long then he'll return to the orb and we'll have to start over!
rows.quest:4961:details:3: BSo get yourself ready, ⟦29⟧. Prepare your strongest spells and keep your potions handy, and go get a friend if you have one. Because this isn't going to be pretty.
rows.quest:4961:completion:0: Nicely done, ⟦30⟧! You gave that demon a lesson he won't soon forget. You've shown great power and skill. Now I suppose it's time you return to Menara with your cleansed orb so you can put it to good use.
rows.quest:4961:completion:1: BGood luck, ⟦31⟧. Perhaps our paths will cross again.
rows.quest:4962:obj:0: Take the Felhas Ruby and use it on one of the Felhounds found in ⟦E8⟧. After successful, bring the Felhas Ruby and the Imprisoned Felhound Spirit back to Menara Voidrender in the ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:4962:details:0: So, you have chosen to capture the soul of a felhound, good.
rows.quest:4962:details:1: BTake this ruby--with it, you will be able to capture the creature's soul. It works very similar to spells you already know: when the creature is close to dying, use the gem and it should do the rest of the work for you.
rows.quest:4962:details:2: BI would suggest going to ⟦E8⟧ and trying your hand at any of the felhounds there. Those should do nicely.
rows.quest:4962:details:3: BAfter you're successful, take both the captured spirit and your ruby to Menara.
rows.quest:4962:completion:0: Ah, the spirit of a felhound. Well done, ⟦32⟧.
rows.quest:4962:completion:1: BWhen I have both the spirit and the cleansed orb, I will merge the two for you, but not until then.
rows.quest:4963:obj:0: Take the Infus Emerald and use it on one of the Infernals found in ⟦E8⟧. After successful, bring the Infus Emerald and the Imprisoned Infernal Spirit back to Menara Voidrender in the ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:4963:details:0: So, you have chosen to capture the soul of an infernal, good.
rows.quest:4963:details:1: BTake this emerald--with it, you will be able to capture the creature's soul. It works very similar to spells you already know: when the creature is close to dying, use the gem and it should do the rest of the work for you.
rows.quest:4963:details:2: BI would suggest going to ⟦E8⟧ and trying your hand at any of the infernals there. Those should do nicely.
rows.quest:4963:details:3: BAfter you're successful, take both the captured spirit and your emerald to Menara.
rows.quest:4963:completion:0: Ah, the spirit of an infernal. Well done, ⟦33⟧.
rows.quest:4963:completion:1: BWhen I have both the spirit and the cleansed orb, I will merge the two for you, but not until then.
rows.quest:4964:obj:0: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete the Orb of Dar'Orahil and then speak to her again.
rows.quest:4964:details:0: I will get started immediately on crafting your orb and infusing your new demon into it. When done, you will have the choice of having it in the form of a staff or orb. I always felt it was important to cater to a warlock's chosen weapon... I see no reason not to continue that practice.
rows.quest:4964:completion:0: It is done, ⟦34⟧. Simply tell me which you'd prefer: a staff that would require you to use both hands, or an orb so you may use a dagger or sword as your weapon.
rows.quest:4964:completion:1: BTackling a felhound was a great feat on your part. I am sure your item will serve you well in the future. Continue to work hard in the arts, ⟦35⟧. I will be awaiting details of your exploits.
rows.quest:4965:obj:0: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:4965:details:0: Well, well, well... a pleasure to see you're growing in power, ⟦36⟧. I'd wager you'd be about ready to speak to Menara Voidrender in the ⟦E6⟧. If you haven't spoken to her before, then let me tell you, I don't think I've ever met another expert in the creation of items--orbs specifically--that can inprison even a demon to serve our will so easily.
rows.quest:4965:details:1: BIf you're interested, she's in Strahad's tower above Ratchet in the ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:4965:completion:0: Ah, you do seek something more... substantial. That I can help you if you truly are prepared.
rows.quest:4965:completion:1: BIt's a welcome change to see one of our kind seeking more power in forms other than just knowledge.
rows.quest:4965:completion:2: BSo, do you feel you're ready, ⟦37⟧?
rows.quest:4967:obj:0: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:4967:details:0: Still a fool, and still seeking the trappings of mortals. Yes, I speak to you with arrogance. I see you before me and I laugh. You're pathetic!
rows.quest:4967:details:1: BBut it matters not what I think. It only matters what those willing to deal with you thinks! And in this case, against my better judgment, those with some portion of power feel you deserve more.
rows.quest:4967:details:2: BIf this is something you strive for then you should speak with Menara Voidrender in the tower above Ratchet. I believe you have met her before some time ago.
rows.quest:4967:completion:0: Ah, you do seek something more... substantial. That I can help you if you truly are prepared.
rows.quest:4967:completion:1: BIt's a welcome change to see one of our kind seeking more power in forms other than just knowledge.
rows.quest:4967:completion:2: BSo, do you feel you're ready, ⟦38⟧?
rows.quest:4968:obj:0: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:4968:details:0: Hmm, you've made it this far... truly astonishing. I would have thought the corruption of channeling the arcane would have seeped into your very soul and driven you mad by now. How about we try and push you further then?
rows.quest:4968:details:1: BIf you want to test your skill, seek out Menara Voidrender above Ratchet in Strahad's tower. She will guide you.
rows.quest:4968:completion:0: Ah, you do seek something more... substantial. That I can help you if you truly are prepared.
rows.quest:4968:completion:1: BIt's a welcome change to see one of our kind seeking more power in forms other than just knowledge.
rows.quest:4968:completion:2: BSo, do you feel you're ready, ⟦39⟧?
rows.quest:4969:obj:0: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:4969:details:0: Haha! You're doing very well for yourself, young ⟦40⟧.
rows.quest:4969:details:1: BGiven time, infernals and dreadlords will bow before you!
rows.quest:4969:details:2: BBut until that time comes, you must still rely on weapons forged by the hands of the mortal races.
rows.quest:4969:details:3: BYou seem prepared for another such creation, and if you are willing, Menara Voidrender would speak with you! She is near Strahad's tower overlooking the port town of Ratchet. Go there when you are ready.
rows.quest:4969:completion:0: Ah, you do seek something more... substantial. I can help you if you truly are prepared.
rows.quest:4969:completion:1: BIt's a welcome change to see one of our kind seeking more power in forms other than just knowledge.
rows.quest:4969:completion:2: BSo, do you feel you're ready, ⟦41⟧?
rows.quest:4975:obj:0: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete the Orb of Noh'Orahil and then speak to her again.
rows.quest:4975:details:0: I will get started immediately on crafting your orb and infusing your new demon into it. When done, you will have the choice of having it in the form of a staff or orb. I always felt it was important to cater to a warlock's chosen weapon... I see no reason not to continue that practice.
rows.quest:4975:completion:0: It is done, ⟦42⟧. Simply tell me which you'd prefer: a staff that would require you to use both hands, or an orb so you may use a dagger or sword as your weapon.
rows.quest:4975:completion:1: BTackling the infernal was a great feat on your part and this reward will fit you nicely. I wish you further success in the arts, ⟦43⟧.
rows.quest:4976:obj:0: Return the Cleansed Infernal Orb to Menara Voidrender in the ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:4976:details:0: Take the cleansed orb back to Menara in Ratchet, ⟦44⟧. Give her my regards and be safe. I truly hope you are able to withstand the temptation and corruption that is sure to come as you follow your path.
rows.quest:4976:completion:0: Well done, ⟦45⟧. This will do nicely.
rows.quest:4976:completion:1: BThe only thing left for you to do is to decide on which demon you want me to imprison within the cleansed orb. Do that, and you will have a magnificent new item to wield.
rows.quest:7562:obj:0: Speak with Mor'zul Bloodbringer in the ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:7562:details:0: ⟦46⟧, your delvings into the dark arts are deep. Your mastery over otherworldly denizens has grown so strong... perhaps you are ready to bind to you one of the infamous dreadsteeds.
rows.quest:7562:details:1: BThe ritual to summon the beast from its home requires great power and resources, but if you desire to dominate that epic mount, then speak with Mor'zul Bloodbringer. He is camped near the Altar of Storms in the ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:7562:details:2: BGo, ⟦47⟧. This quest will be perilous, but a Warlock of your stature does not shy from danger!
rows.quest:7562:completion:0: Greetings, ⟦48⟧, and welcome. Are you here to study near the Altar of Storms as I am, perhaps to harness its energy for some hidden purpose...
rows.quest:7562:completion:1: BOr... are you here to speak with me? Yes, I believe you are.
rows.quest:7562:completion:2: BYou want to master a dreadsteed? Such is no easy task. It will cost you no small amounts of blood, sweat... and of course gold. But a dreadsteed of Xoroth is a prize well worth winning so if interested, listen on...
rows.quest:7563:obj:0: Bring 30 bottles of Raging Beast's Blood to Mor'zul Bloodbringer in the ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:7563:details:0: The dreadsteeds dwell on another world, on the fiery Plains of Xoroth, and to bind one of those famed beasts you must invoke powerful glyphs. I can scribe the glyphs on a parchment for you, but first I will need a special ink.
rows.quest:7563:details:1: BIn distant ⟦E14⟧ there dwells a race of owl beasts. Once pure creatures, they were turned mad by the demonic emanations of the Darkwhisper Gorge and now roam the snows in a frenzy.
rows.quest:7563:details:2: BTheir blood is what I need to ink your parchment. Bring it to me.
rows.quest:7563:completion:0: Ah, very good. I will have this blood distilled into an ink and use it for the parchment I promised you. And perhaps I will save just a little for myself, as I hear its taste is quite euphoric...
rows.quest:7564:obj:0: Bring the Case of Blood to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:7564:details:0: My servant, Gorzeeki, is an alchemist of some skill. He can prepare the ink I will need for your parchment. I gathered together the blood you acquired; take it to Gorzeeki so that he can begin his work.
rows.quest:7564:completion:0: Oh, it's blood. It must be from master Mor'zul then. He is so enamored with the stuff, and loves to see it spilled. I, however, prefer it coursing through the veins of a small rodent. It stays warm that way... until you want it.
rows.quest:7564:completion:1: BThis is powerful blood. Mor'zul must be making another parchment to summon a dreadsteed! How exciting!
rows.quest:7564:completion:2: BIf that's true, and you're going to perform the ritual, then... you're going to need a lot more than blood, my friend.
rows.quest:7581:obj:0: ⟦E15⟧ to Dire ⟦E16⟧ in ⟦E17⟧ and recover 15 Satyr Blood from the Wildspawn Satyr that inhabit the Warpwood Quarter. Return to Daio in the Tainted Scar when this is done.⟦49⟧
rows.quest:7581:details:0: You must retrieve bindings for the prison of the Doomguard from lesser demons.
rows.quest:7581:details:1: BThe blood of the Wildspawn satyr that occupy Dire ⟦E16⟧ should do nicely. The coagulated blood will bond the Hederine shards and power the crystal prison.
rows.quest:7581:completion:0: Ah, a most excellent recovery. The blood will suppress the Doomguard's magical defenses.
rows.quest:7582:obj:0: ⟦E15⟧ to Darkwhisper Gorge in ⟦E14⟧ and recover 5 Tears of the Hederine from the Hederine demons that occupy the gorge. Return to Daio in the Tainted Scar when you have completed this task.
rows.quest:7582:details:0: The Hederine demons that occupy the foothills of ⟦E18⟧ secrete powerful fel poisons, which if left to mature, harden into a dense anti-magic crystal. These crystals have come to be known as Tears of the Hederine.
rows.quest:7582:details:1: BNot even the immense power of a Doomguard could break the walls of a prison constructed from this material.
rows.quest:7582:details:2: BTravel to Darkwhisper Gorge in ⟦E14⟧ and recover the Tears.
rows.quest:7582:completion:0: I merely need to combine the blood of the Wildspawn with these crystals and the prison shall be ready for use.
rows.quest:7583:obj:0: Venture forth into the Tainted Scar and locate a Doomguard Commander.
rows.quest:7583:obj:1: BUse the Glowing Crystal Prison on the Doomguard Commander. Be prepared for a ferocious onslaught of attacks, as the demon attempts to escape capture.
rows.quest:7583:obj:2: BShould you succeed, return the Imprisoned Doomguard to Daio in the Tainted Scar.
rows.quest:7583:details:0: The prison is ready. Now for the most difficult portion of this task.
rows.quest:7583:details:1: BYou must find and capture a Doomguard Commander within the Tainted Scar using this crystal prison.
rows.quest:7583:details:2: BBe warned! A Doomguard is a cunning and lethal adversary and will seek to destroy you as you begin the ritual of imprisonment. It will flail wildly in its attempts to escape imprisonment.
rows.quest:7583:details:3: BIt will focus on nothing but you, ⟦50⟧. Because of this, I must recommend that you take companions capable of keeping you alive!
rows.quest:7583:completion:0: You have done as I have asked. You are ready to be given the knowledge to conjure and control the beast.
rows.quest:7601:details:0: If I am to teach you the secrets of summoning an infernal servant, you must destroy Kroshius and bring me the infernal core from his burning remains. This, however, is not as easy as it sounds. Kroshius has all but burned out completely. You must reignite his corpse and raise him from the rubble. To do this, however, you must gather some components from other demonic entities.
rows.quest:7601:details:1: BMy imp, Impsy, shall set you on your way.
rows.quest:7601:completion:0: Oh boy, here we go again.
rows.quest:7602:obj:0: Impsy in ⟦E19⟧ has asked that you bring him three Flawless Fel Essences originating from three distinct locations.
rows.quest:7602:obj:1: BThe Legashi Satyrs of ⟦E20⟧ hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region. The Jaedenar Legionnaires of Jaedenar hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region. The Felguard Sentries of the ⟦E21⟧ hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region.
rows.quest:7602:obj:2: BRecover the Flawless Fel Essences and return to Impsy in ⟦E19⟧.
rows.quest:7602:details:0: If you're going to reanimate Kroshius, you're going to need Fel fire. I can make Fel fire but it's going to require some components.
rows.quest:7602:details:1: BYou need to bring me flawless Fel essences from three distinct regions of the world.
rows.quest:7602:details:2: BThe Legashi Satyrs of ⟦E20⟧ will have the first essence type; the Jaedenar legionnaires of Jaedenar the second type and the felguard sentries of the ⟦E21⟧ the third.
rows.quest:7602:details:3: BBring me back one of each essence type and I will create the Fel fire, allowing you to reanimate Kroshius.
rows.quest:7602:completion:0: Give me a minute and I'll combine the essences into Fel fire.
rows.quest:7603:obj:0: Search Shatter Scar Vale in ⟦E19⟧ for the remains of Kroshius. When you locate the remains, use the Fel ⟦E22⟧ near them and await Kroshius' return. When the infernal has awoken, slay him and take from his corpse Kroshius' Infernal Core.
rows.quest:7603:obj:1: BReturn Kroshius' Infernal Core to Niby the Almighty in ⟦E19⟧.
rows.quest:7603:details:0: Kroshius lays in a heap to the northeast, in the Shatter Scar Vale. Take this Fel fire and use it on his remains. The fire should reanimate the fallen infernal.
rows.quest:7603:details:1: BAt this point, I fully expect him to kill you and your minion.
rows.quest:7603:details:2: BIf by some miracle you happen to kill Kroshius, take his infernal core and return it to Niby.
rows.quest:7603:completion:0: A deal is a deal! Quickly, take this and write this down. I don't have time! My greatest conjuration is upon us!
